summary: Executed backend pytest regression and frontend e2e flows (customer signup/signin, cart->checkout, admin dashboard/order status). Core Convex flows passed on localhost. Public preview host remains blocked by Vite allowedHosts, preventing reliable public URL UI verification.

ui_bugs.issue: App renders Vite host-block page: host not allowed (vite-react-shop.cluster-0.preview.emergentcf.cloud).

integration_issues.issue: Browser cannot use external preview URL due to Vite allowedHosts mismatch; testing had to continue on localhost:3000.

action_items: Fix Vite allowedHosts/preview host configuration so public preview URL is usable from browser automation.
Populate /app/memory/test_credentials.md with current admin/test-user credentials per auth testing policy.
Add missing data-testid attributes for key admin interactions (orders status dropdown, tab buttons, product create/edit controls) to improve testability.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.tsx is 845 lines; exceeds maintainability guideline and should be split.
Many interactive admin controls are missing data-testid attributes, reducing automation reliability.
Settings copy still references Supabase function secrets despite Convex migration; update wording to avoid architectural confusion.
seed_data_creation: Created customer qa_1777934119@example.com and one MOCKED checkout order (order confirmation flow).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend functional flows passed on localhost (products render, Convex auth, cart/checkout with randomized shipping, admin signin, status update). Public preview URL currently blocked by Vite host allowlist, so re-test on public URL after host fix.
rca of the issue: RCA: Public preview route serves Vite host-validation block page. Repro: open https://header-polish-3.preview.emergentagent.com in browser automation environment; page shows 'Blocked request. This host (...) is not allowed.' Root cause is Vite allowedHosts missing runtime preview hostname. Mitigation: include preview host(s) in Vite allowedHosts (or equivalent proxy-safe setting) and redeploy. Also keep Razorpay flow explicitly MOCKED until real credentials are provided.
